_readme: Rizal's walkthrough (SRS v2.3 §3.7). Shown on first visit and from Settings > 'Replay the tour'. Each step: target = data-guide id of the element to highlight (null = centred card), route = page it runs on, mood = portrait row, text <= 32 words, next = 'button' or 'click-target'. The guide is a framing device: Rizal's real words appear only in stops, marked 'recorded'. Never show the guide on the final stop (GD-6).
speaker: rizal

tour.text: Good day! I am José Rizal. Welcome to Lakbay Rizal, "Rizal's journey". Come, travel with me through the places where I lived, studied and wrote.
This is the map. Each pin marks a place on my journey, from Calamba, where I was born in 1861, to Manila in 1896.
My travels crossed four regions: the Philippines, Asia, Europe and America. Switch between them here.
Slide through the years to follow my path in order. Thirty-five years, twenty-five stops.
In Guided mode, stops open one at a time. In Free mode, you may go anywhere. I suggest Guided for your first journey.
The glowing pin is your next stop: Calamba. Tap it, and we begin.
Every stop is a story in chapters. Read each part, then press Next. When someone speaks, you will see them up close.
A line marked "Recorded" uses my real words, from my own writings. Lines marked "Dramatized" are imagined, but based on real events.
Here are the books and letters each story comes from. A good student, like a good historian, checks the sources.
After the story comes a short quiz. You will order events, match names, and even find mistakes. Think like a historian!
Right answers earn experience points, stamps and keepsakes. Answer well in a row to build a streak. Begin as an Estudyante; finish as an Ilustrado.
Your passport keeps every stamp you earn. Your journal keeps every keepsake. Visit them often.
Your journey saves itself in this browser. Watch for this sign. To be safe, download a save code from Settings every few stops.
That is all you need. My mother was my first teacher, and this is where my story begins. Shall we?

quiz-first.text: Read each question carefully. If you are stuck, the hint points you back to the story. Every answer is in the chapters you just read.

passport-first.text: Your first stamp! I collected many in my own passport. Twenty-four more are waiting.

journal-first.text: Keepsakes tell my story through objects: a pen, a book, a ticket. Tap one to read about it.

builder-first.text: In Dapitan I built a school, a clinic and a water system with my pupils. Now it is your turn. Use the materials you earned on the journey.

gallery-first.text: Every scene you unlock is kept here. Look closely: each one was drawn from descriptions of the real place and year.

settings-first.text: Here you can change the text size and language, turn motion down, and download or load a save code.

private-mode.text: You seem to be in a private window. Your progress will be erased when you close it. Download a save code to keep it.

rank-up.text: A new rank! I was once a small boy at the end of the line at the Ateneo. Look how far you have come.

correct.text: Well done. My teachers would be proud.

wrong.text: Not quite. Look again; the answer is in the story.
Even I began at the end of the line. Try once more.
Read the hint, then try again. A historian checks twice.

streak.text: Five in a row! You are becoming emperor of this class.
Ten in a row! Even Father Bech would applaud.

perfect.text: A perfect score. That deserves a medal, and here it is.
